bio: Hello! My name is Florencia Luz Duarte. I am a Front-end Developer and Product Designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

texts.text1: After 10+ years working as a Designer, I decided to give programming a chance and it ended up stealing my heart (professionally speaking).
texts.text2: What started with a few lines of code, ended up scaling to a professional transformation, which has led me to learn web programming on my own for the last 2+ years.
texts.text3: During this process, I have managed to:
texts.text4: My mission is to act as a bridge between the worlds of Programming and Design, making the most of both facets of my professional journey for the development of websites and apps.
